name: MAGIX
summary: MAGIX is based at MESA, Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz. This multipurpose precision electron-scattering experiment explicitly includes dark-sector research.
detection_principle: A high-intensity low-energy electron beam interacts with an internal gas-jet target; dual-arm high-resolution magnetic spectrometers and recoil detectors search for narrow resonances and missing mass.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
